title: AI-led shopping and rising PC costs both demand a store rethink
summary: NIQ: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery; Amazon: 400M used Alexa for Shopping, spending 50% more. Asus expects commercial PC prices up ~10% in 2H26; Apple forecasts a holiday margin drop and added touchscreen Macs.

points.headline: AI is now where shoppers start, and agents are being built to keep them inside
points.detail: NIQ: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery; Amazon says 400M used Alexa for Shopping and spend 50% more. Our listings and content must work for AI agents.

points.headline: Memory costs are lifting PC prices, and Apple now warns of margin pressure
points.detail: Asus sees Taiwan commercial PC prices up nearly 10% in 2H26; Samsung sees no memory relief before 2028; Apple forecasts a holiday-quarter margin drop. Plan pricing and stock.

points.headline: Apple adds touchscreen Macs and posts a record quarter, raising the premium laptop bar
points.detail: Apple showed its first touchscreen laptops and reported record US$114.5B September-quarter revenue on strong Mac sales. Review our touch lineup and online positioning.

points.headline: Agent payment rails are forming as Mastercard teams with OpenAI and Tencent
points.detail: Mastercard formed partnerships with OpenAI and Tencent to drive agentic commerce. We should confirm our checkout and payments can support agent-initiated purchases.
